one_liner: Loka AI uses locally hosted AI to search and enrich executive-search firms’ internal candidate pools; a February 2026 EXIST grant makes this a timely lead.

top_signals.signal: BayStartUP recognized Loka AI in its Bavarian Business Plan Competition; the funding summary records second place in March 2025.
Awarded the EXIST Start-up Grant in February 2026.

Model score 82.6 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). Four listed team members, technical expertise, a PhD and TUM ties lifted the score. University spin-off status also lifted it but is not confirmed by founder records. The deep-tech classification helped; being based in Germany weighed slightly against it.

team: Dr. Markus Binder is an AI specialist with a PhD, TUM ties and prior BMW Group R&D experience. Ha Do has over ten years in B2B SaaS product development, and Eugen Paul has 13 years building and scaling HR-tech SaaS businesses. Ahmad Owaydate is listed as AI Founder Associate, with TUM ties and AI research experience at BMW Group R&D.
why_early: Priced-round status is unknown. The funding summary lists €25,000 from AI+Munich in March 2024 and an EXIST grant in February 2026, but does not establish whether a priced round has occurred.
devils_advocate_risks: Integration with existing HR systems and workflows may be difficult.
It is unclear how much customization different search firms will require.
next_step: HTGF Digital Tech team: Ask the founders how many executive-search firms are currently paying to use the product.
